_comment: Clean benchmark: a subset of the 74-case benchmark with every case whose reference answer is missing, disputed, convention-dependent or inconsistent with the computed cell removed, plus structurally wrong/suspect cells, broken Wannierisations and duplicates. Element values come from reference_os.json (single source of truth); this file only selects cases and adds per-atom labels. Exclusion criteria use properties of the reference answer and of the input only, never the assignment result. Evaluated by script/clean_bench.py.

rules.convention: IUPAC ionic approximation: heteronuclear bond electrons go to the partner with higher Allen electronegativity; homonuclear bond electrons are split equally.
rules.site_labels: Per-element site spec: a number = every atom of that element; "mean" = element mean only (no per-atom label is chemically defined); {count, within, map} = number of <count>-element neighbours within <within> Angstrom (minimum image) selects the label from map.
rules.exclude.convention: Some element pair in the cell has Allen |dchi| < 0.15, or Allen and Pauling order the pair oppositely; the answer then depends on the electronegativity table, not on the electronic structure.
rules.exclude.disputed: The literature gives conflicting assignments and the reference follows one of them.
rules.exclude.ref_mismatch: The reference answer was written for a different compound than the computed cell.
rules.exclude.broken_wannier: More than half of the Wannier functions are unlocalised (stray), so centres carry no chemical information.
rules.exclude.duplicate: Same compound and phase as another case; the kept copy is named in detail.
rules.exclude.structure: Structure audit (docs/testset_registry.tsv, 2026-07-12) verdict WRONG or SUSPECT for the cell currently in the data directory.
rules.overrides: A case listed under overrides is scored from the rerun in that directory instead of the 74-case benchmark directory. rb2cucl4: the archived run had no spin polarisation (ISPIN default 1), so the d9 Cu(+2) could not be represented with 2-electron WFs and Cu was scored on its element mean only; the ISPIN = 2 rerun (2026-10-12, same structure and INCAR plus ISPIN = 2 and MAGMOM 1.0 on Cu) restores per-atom Cu labels.
